title.en: An Act Converting Doña Gregoria Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, into a National Hospital to be Known as Doña Gregoria National Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting Doña Gregoria Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, into a National Hospital to be Known as Doña Gregoria National Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Tưởng niệm Doña Gregoria tại Đô thị Agoo, Tỉnh La Union thành Bệnh viện Quốc gia với tên gọi Doña Gregoria National Hospital, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Doña Gregoria ในเทศบาล Agoo จังหวัด La Union เป็น โรงพยาบาลแห่งชาติ ในชื่อ Doña Gregoria National Hospital และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Memorial Doña Gregoria di Kotamadya Agoo, Provinsi La Union menjadi Rumah Sakit Nasional dengan nama Doña Gregoria National Hospital, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Memorial Doña Gregoria di Perbandaran Agoo, Wilayah La Union kepada Hospital Kebangsaan dengan nama Doña Gregoria National Hospital, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en: Doña Gregoria Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, is hereby converted into a national hospital to be known as Doña Gregoria National Hospital.

The sum two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purpose of this Act. Every year thereafter, the said sum must be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
